values.title: Electron and muon magnetic-anomaly comparison
values.statement: The bare g, terminal-alpha leading structure and squared mass sensitivity are compared only with the raw NIST electron data and Fermilab final muon measurement; no consensus-model interpretation enters the validation path.

values.exact_result: The currently sealed leading terminal-alpha/full-turn translation is compared with both raw measured anomalies; the raw measurements remain the sole empirical targets while a separately forced successor is constructed.
values.induction_base: The exact bare and terminal-alpha leading carriers seal first.
values.induction_step: Electron and muon raw measurement rows append without selecting any successor or importing a consensus-model comparison.
exclusions: no exact-measured-anomaly claim from a leading term
target_rows: complete registered NIST/PDG/Fermilab/Planck vector including unfavorable and scope rows
values.falsification_condition: A complete separately sealed SFT radiative successor fails the measured intervals, or this validation mislabels the current leading-only result as the full anomaly.
